agentPersonaValidation.instructionRequired: Describe how the agent should behave

fixFinding.prompt: In document [{{docCode}}](doc:{{docId}}) the «{{ruleId}}» check reported: «{{message}}»{{location}}. Find this spot in the .tex, explain the cause and fix it so the finding is resolved per ESPD/GOST requirements.

requirementsFormat.prompt: Help configure the requirements-recognition format for traceability in this project. The «{{kindLabel}}» format is currently active. First look at how requirement identifiers are actually written in the sources — use grep_project and read_tex on the TЗ and other documents in the package. Then pick a suitable format: macro (\req{ID}{text} definitions and \reqref{ID} references), id (identifier regex + source documents) or custom (your own def_pattern with (?P<id>…) and ref_pattern with (?P<ids>…)). Check your candidate with the preview_requirements_format tool and show how many requirements were found, covered, without references and without a definition. Once a variant works, apply it via set_requirements_format. Briefly explain each step.
